name: Email Claim Capture Agent
fn: Parses claim emails and attachments, extracts and links deduction details
detail: Parses deduction claims from emails and attachments, extracts the detail and auto-links to the matching deduction. Removes manual claim intake.
sap: SAP FSCM-DM · SD-TPM / Vistex programmes · FI-AR credit memo (FB75) · CO write-off postings
